newsitem.title: USA: Marcum forms trust to expand facility.
newsitem.headline: Marcum forms trust to expand facility.

text.p: Marcum Natural Gas Services Inc said Monday that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Marcum Gas Transmission Inc, has formed Marcum Midstream 1997-1 Business Trust, of which Marcum Gas Transmission is the managing trustee.
The Business Trust purchased and plans to expand an existing natural gas liquids processing facility (fractionator) near Midland/Odessa, Texas.
The purchase and planned expansion was financed by an $8 million private placement of preferred shares of the Business Trust, including a $400,000 investment by Marcum Gas Transmission.
The facility, located on 55 acres of land opened in July of 1995, currently has the capacity to process 8,000 barrels of natural gas liquids per day.
In addition to purchasing the facility, proceeds from the private placement will be used to expand the plant to process 12,000 barrels per day by year end.
The plant produces ethane, propane, butane, isobutane and natural gasoline products.
Marcum will be entitled to 12.5 percent of cash available for distribution from the Business Trust until payout.
If certain payout conditions are met, Marcum's interest will increase to 23.75 percent.
